name: Valentine
description: Let site users send valentines to each other.
project_description:
💙💛 
 
 This module is maintained by Ukrainian developers. 
Please consider supporting Ukraine in a fight for their freedom and safety of Europe. 
 
 
 
 The module provides functionality for sending valentines to other site users.

 Features 
 
 Creation form 
You should see a red button to open a form to prepare and send a new valentine when you go to any user page (for example, /user/1 ). This button can have the shape of a heart or a simple rectangle. Also, the button is placed in one of the four corners of the page. As for the creation form, you can write a message (required) in plain text and a signature (optional). So, if the last field is left blank then no one will know who sent the valentine (even users who have direct access to the database). 
 View messages 
A similar button to open the page of received messages should be available on all other pages (in case when you have at least one message that was sent in the current year). The number of new messages should be contained in the button label when you have unread ones. 
 Clean up 
Valentines from previous years may be removed automatically via cron when the relevant field on the settings page does not have zero value. 
 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Mobile Detect : When enabled, modal windows can use the full width of the screen when you use a mobile phone.

 Additional Requirements 
 
 Service (for version 2.0.0 and newer)
